test_system_info_device_details.title: Verify system information displays correct device details

steps.expected: Model name and Manufacturer match the registry entry for this camera, and a serial number starting with PC is shown.
Max resolution and Max framerate (fps) match the registry entry.
AI is SUPPORTED, and PTZ is listed for models the registry marks as not supporting it.
It shows the ONVIF version from the registry (24.06 unless set) with its profiles.

test_device_name_and_location_editable.title: Verify device name and location are editable and persist

steps.action: Open Setup > SYSTEM > SYSTEM INFORMATION and note the Device name and Location.
steps.expected: Both fields are editable.

steps.action: Change Device name to TEST-CAM-01 and Location to QA Lab, then click Apply.
steps.expected: The change is accepted.

steps.action: Refresh the page and reopen SYSTEM > SYSTEM INFORMATION.
steps.expected: Device name reads TEST-CAM-01 and Location reads QA Lab.

steps.action: Put the original name and location back and click Apply.
steps.expected: The original values are restored (the test restores them even when a step fails).

test_plugins_installed_and_running.title: Verify both SOTERIX and VCAedge-AI plugins are installed and running

steps.expected: The SOTERIX and VCAedge-AI plugins are listed.
At least two plugins show running.

test_plugin_storage_within_limits.title: Verify plugin storage usage is below 90%

steps.action: Open Setup > SYSTEM > PLUG-IN and read the storage usage.
steps.expected: A usage percentage is shown.
Usage is below 90%.

test_firmware_and_diagnostics_accessible.title: Verify firmware version and system diagnostics are accessible

steps.expected: The firmware page shows the running firmware version as a dated build (for example 2025.06.30_A20.3.3) and a control to select a firmware file.
The diagnostics page is shown.
The system log page is shown.

test_date_time_settings.title: Verify date/time settings and language options

steps.expected: The date and time page shows the time settings (NTP or manual).
The DST page is shown.
The language page is shown.

test_configuration_backup_accessible.title: Verify configuration backup page is accessible

steps.expected: The CONFIGURATION BACKUP page offers a backup (export or download) option.

test_camera_restart.title: Verify camera can restart cleanly and retains settings

steps.action: Open Setup > SYSTEM > PLUG-IN and note how many plugins show running.
steps.expected: The count is known for the check after the restart.

steps.action: Open SYSTEM > RESTART and click Restart.
steps.expected: The camera goes offline.

steps.action: Wait for the camera to come back (up to 3 minutes).
steps.expected: The setup page answers again.
At least as many plugins show running as before the restart.
